Toque libère le moteur et lance l'appli:
Toque releases the motor and opens the stock Monsieur Cuisine app, which syncs with Lidl's servers as usual.

Then come back to Toque with the “Back to Toque” button shown on top of it (you can drag it): the recipes will be imported automatically.
Toque libère le moteur, rend l'accès à l: Toque releases the motor, gives access back to the stock Monsieur Cuisine app and switches to Demo mode. Toque will no longer open when the robot starts.
Toque télécharge lui-même les recettes o: Toque downloads the official Monsieur Cuisine connect recipes from monsieur-cuisine.com itself (no account needed).
Toque va la télécharger depuis GitHub, l: Toque will download it from GitHub, install it and restart (about a minute). The motor stays stopped meanwhile.
Toque va prendre le contrôle du moteur e:
Toque will take control of the motor and heater instead of the stock app.

First test: empty bowl, lid closed, within reach of the main switch. If anything seems wrong, switch it off.
